verifications.claim: Participating U.S. Wendy's offer a free Small Fry and Small Frosty (chocolate or vanilla) on Tuesday, April 7, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'free small fry and Frosty on April 7th ... small chocolate or vanilla Frosty ... participating Wendy’s restaurants ... U.S. Wendy’s locations'; R2: 'one small fries and one small Frosty Classic ... Small Hot & Crispy Fry ... Small Chocolate or Vanilla Frosty Classic ... on April 7'; R3: 'one free Small Hot & Crispy Fry paired with a Small Chocolate or Vanilla Frosty® Classic ... participating Wendy's restaurants ... Tuesday, April 7 ... U.S. Wendy's locations ... April 7, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state the offer details including items, flavors, date (April 7, 2026 in R3, contextually in others), and U.S. participating locations.

verifications.claim: No purchase is necessary for the offer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'no, you don’t have to buy anything else'; R3: 'no purchase necessary'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in R1 and R3.

verifications.claim: No app is required for the offer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'available in-restaurant only'; R2: 'available upon request in Wendy’s restaurants only'; R3: 'available in-restaurant and drive-thru only ... Not valid for digital or delivery orders'
verifications.reasoning: All specify in-restaurant/drive-thru upon request and exclude digital/delivery/app orders, directly supporting no app required.

verifications.claim: The offer is only available in-restaurant or in the drive-thru.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'available in-restaurant only'; R2: 'in Wendy’s restaurants only'; R3: 'available in-restaurant and drive-thru only'
verifications.reasoning: R1 and R2 indicate in-restaurant/restaurants only (excluding drive-thru), while R3 explicitly includes drive-thru; sources contradict.

verifications.claim: The offer is available while supplies last.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'only while stocks last'; R3: 'While supplies last'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in R2 and R3.

verifications.claim: The offer provides one free small fry and one small Frosty per person.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'one free small fry, paired with a small chocolate or vanilla Frosty'; R2: 'one small fries and one small Frosty Classic per person'; R3: 'Limit one (1) free Small Fry and Small Frosty Classic per person'
verifications.reasoning: All references specify one of each item per person.

verifications.claim: The offer is available at participating U.S. Wendy's in-store and drive-thru only.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'in-restaurant only ... participating Wendy’s restaurants ... U.S. Wendy’s locations'; R2: 'in Wendy’s restaurants only ... across the US'; R3: 'in-restaurant and drive-thru only ... participating U.S. Wendy's'
verifications.reasoning: R1 and R2 limit to in-restaurant/restaurants (excluding drive-thru), R3 includes drive-thru; contradictory information.

verifications.claim: The promotion is part of Wendy's "Free Dunks for America" campaign.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '“Free Dunks for America”'; R2: '“free dunks for America”'; R3: 'Free Dunks for America'
verifications.reasoning: All references name it as 'Free Dunks for America' tied to the promotion.

verifications.claim: Wendy's "Free Dunks for America" campaign celebrates the NCAA Basketball Championship.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'thanks to one NCAA player ... NCAA Division I Men’s Basketball National Championship Game'; R2: 'first dunk in the NCAA March Madness ... official partners with NCAA March Madness'; R3: 'first dunk was made during the NCAA® Division I Men's Basketball National Championship Game ... Official Dunks partner of NCAA March Madness'
verifications.reasoning: All link the campaign directly to NCAA March Madness/Basketball Championship celebration.
